title: Leveraging federalism for flexible and robust management of social-ecological systems
Optimal spatial evaluation of a pro rata vaccine distribution rule for COVID-19
A Bioeconomic Local General Equilibrium Assessment of Distributional Consequences of Small-Scale Fisheries Reform in Developing Countries
abstract: Fisheries reform can increase wealth created by degraded small-scale developing-world fisheries. However, empirical studies of distributional consequences of reforms are scarce. Previous empirical studies largely focus on the fishing sector in isolation or do not disaggregate households into socioeconomic groups. We assess the distributional consequences of a fishery reform using a bioeconomic local general equilibrium model estimated and calibrated with data from a Philippine municipality. We disaggregate households into fishing and nonfishing households with different income levels. Fishing households overcome initial losses as the fish stock recovers, with wealthier fishing households attaining larger absolute gains. Nonfishing households suffer negative spillovers and higher fish prices, and gain only moderately as the fish stock recovers, leaving them worse off over the 20-year period assessed. Our results suggest a need for complementary policies to redress short-run losses and heterogeneous outcomes across households. We also examine how trade mediates the impacts of the reform.
abstract_zh: 渔业改革能够增加发展中国家小规模退化渔业所创造的财富。然而，关于改革分配后果的实证研究较为稀缺。以往的实证研究大多孤立地关注渔业部门，或者没有将家庭按社会经济群体进行细分。我们利用一个菲律宾市镇的数据，估计并校准了一个生物经济地方一般均衡模型，以评估一项渔业改革的分配后果。我们将家庭划分为不同收入水平的渔业家庭和非渔业家庭。随着鱼类种群的恢复，渔业家庭最终能够克服初期损失，其中较富裕的渔业家庭获得的绝对收益更大。非渔业家庭则承受负向溢出效应和更高的鱼价，随着鱼类种群恢复，其获益仅属温和，在所评估的20年期间内仍处于更差境况。我们的结果表明，需要配套政策来弥补短期损失，并应对各家庭之间的异质性结果。我们还考察了贸易如何调节改革的影响。

title: Are simultaneously-decided referenda substitutable? Evidence from municipal land use ballot measures
abstract: The results of ballot referenda have often been used to infer the preferences of voters for various types of policy. However, voters may be influenced by the appearance of competing ballot referenda. We propose a simple theoretical framework for considering the substitutability or complementarity of various land use policies and apply this framework to a novel dataset of 603 land-related municipal ballot measures in California. We find that the appearance of a competing anti-growth measure decreases support for other anti-growth measures, while the appearance of pro-growth measures do not affect the likelihood of passage for anti-growth or pro-growth measures.
abstract_zh: 公投结果常被用于推断选民对各类政策的偏好。然而，选民可能会受到同时出现的其他公投议题的影响。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架，用以考察各类土地利用政策之间的替代性或互补性，并将该框架应用于加利福尼亚州603项与土地相关的市政公投议题的新数据集。我们发现，同时出现一项反增长竞争性议题，会降低选民对其他反增长议题的支持，而出现的支持增长议题则不影响反增长或支持增长议题的通过可能性。

title: Citizens of local jurisdictions enhance plant community preservation through ballot initiatives and voter-driven conservation efforts
Direct and ancillary benefits of ecosystem-based fisheries management in forage fish fisheries
Political Economy of Renewable Resource Federalism
abstract: The authority to manage natural capital often follows political boundaries rather than ecological. This mismatch can lead to unsustainable outcomes, as spillovers from one management area to the next may create adverse incentives for local decision making, even within a single country. At the same time, one‐size‐fits‐all approaches of federal (centralized) authority can fail to respond to state (decentralized) heterogeneity and can result in inefficient economic or detrimental ecological outcomes. Here we utilize a spatially explicit coupled natural–human system model of a fishery to illuminate trade‐offs posed by the choice between federal vs. state control of renewable resources. We solve for the dynamics of fishing effort and fish stocks that result from different approaches to federal management that vary in terms of flexibility. Adapting numerical methods from engineering, we also solve for the open‐loop Nash equilibrium characterizing state management outcomes, where each state anticipates and responds to the choices of the others. We consider traditional federalism questions (state vs. federal management) as well as more contemporary questions about the economic and ecological impacts of shifting regulatory authority from one level to another. The key mechanisms behind the trade‐offs include whether differences in local conditions are driven by biological or economic mechanisms; degree of flexibility embedded in the federal management; the spatial and temporal distribution of economic returns across states; and the status‐quo management type. While simple rules‐of‐thumb are elusive, our analysis reveals the complex political economy dimensions of renewable resource federalism.
abstract_zh: 管理自然资本的权力往往遵循政治边界而非生态边界。这种错配可能导致不可持续的结果，因为一个管理区域的外溢效应可能会为本地决策者制造不利的激励，即使在单一国家之内也是如此。与此同时，联邦（集中）权力的“一刀切”做法，可能无法应对各州（分散）的异质性，并可能导致低效的经济结果或有害的生态后果。在此，我们利用一个空间明确的自然—人类耦合系统渔业模型，来阐明在联邦控制与州控制可再生资源之间所面临的权衡。我们求解了不同灵活性的联邦管理方式下，捕捞努力量和鱼类种群的动态演变。我们还借鉴工程学中的数值方法，求解了州管理结果对应的开环纳什均衡，其中每个州都会预期并回应其他州的选择。我们既考察了传统的联邦主义问题（州管理与联邦管理之比较），也探讨了更具当代意义的问题，即将监管权力从一个层级转移到另一层级，会带来怎样的经济和生态影响。这些权衡背后的关键机制包括：当地条件的差异是由生物机制还是经济机制驱动；联邦管理中内嵌的灵活性程度；各州之间经济回报的空间与时间分布；以及现状管理类型。尽管简单的经验法则难以寻得，但我们的分析揭示了可再生资源联邦制中复杂的政治经济学维度。

title: Protected Areas Established by Local Communities through Direct Democracy Encompass Habitat for Species as Effectively as Protected Areas Planned over Large Spatial Scales

title: Accounting for Fleet Heterogeneity in Estimating the Impacts of Large-Scale Fishery Closures
Cost-effectiveness of combining drug and environmental treatments for environmentally transmitted diseases
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
abstract: Control of neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) via mass drug administration (MDA) has increased considerably over the past decade, but strategies focused exclusively on human treatment show limited efficacy. This paper investigated trade-offs between drug and environmental treatments in the fight against NTDs by using schistosomiasis as a case study. We use optimal control techniques where the planner’s objective is to treat the disease over a time horizon at the lowest possible total cost, where the total costs include treatment, transportation and damages (reduction in human health). We show that combining environmental treatments and drug treatments reduces the dependency on MDAs and that this reduction increases when the planners take a longer-run perspective on the fight to reduce NTDs. Our results suggest that NTDs with environmental reservoirs require moving away from a reliance solely on MDA to integrated treatment involving investment in both drug and environmental controls.
abstract_zh: 通过大规模药物给药（MDA）控制被忽视的热带病，在过去十年中已大幅增加，但仅侧重于人体治疗的策略效果有限。本文以血吸虫病为案例，考察了在防治被忽视热带病的过程中，药物治疗与环境治理之间的权衡。我们采用最优控制技术，规划者的目标是在给定时间范围内以最低总成本治理该疾病，其中总成本包括治疗成本、运输成本和损害（对人体健康的损失）。我们表明，将环境治理与药物治疗相结合，可以减少对大规模药物给药的依赖，并且当规划者在消除被忽视热带病的努力中采取更长远的视角时，这种减少的幅度会增大。我们的结果表明，对于存在环境宿主库的被忽视热带病，需要从单纯依赖大规模药物给药，转向包含药物与环境双重控制投资的综合治理。

title: Evaluating sustainable development policies in rural coastal economies
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Sustainable development (SD) policies targeting marine economic sectors, designed to alleviate poverty and conserve marine ecosystems, have proliferated in recent years. Many developing countries are providing poor fishing households with new fishing boats (fishing capital) that can be used further offshore as a means to improve incomes and relieve fishing pressure on nearshore fish stocks. These kinds of policies are a marine variant of traditional SD policies focused on agriculture. Here, we evaluate ex ante economic and environmental impacts of provisions of fishing and agricultural capital, with and without enforcement of fishing regulations that prohibit the use of larger vessels in nearshore habitats. Combining methods from development economics, natural resource economics, and marine ecology, we use a unique dataset and modeling framework to account for linkages between households, business sectors, markets, and local fish stocks. We show that the policies investing capital in local marine fisheries or agricultural sectors achieve income gains for targeted households, but knock-on effects lead to increased harvest of nearshore fish, making them unlikely to achieve conservation objectives in rural coastal economies. However, pairing an agriculture stimulus with increasing enforcement of existing fisheries' regulations may lead to a win-win situation. While marine-based policies could be an important tool to achieve two of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (alleviate poverty and protect vulnerable marine resources), their success is by no means assured and requires consideration of land and marine socioeconomic linkages inherent in rural economies.
abstract_zh: 以减贫和保护海洋生态系统为目标的海洋经济部门可持续发展（SD）政策近年来大量涌现。许多发展中国家正在为贫困渔业家庭提供新的渔船（渔业资本），使其能够驶向更远的近海，以此提高收入，并减轻对近岸鱼类种群的捕捞压力。这类政策是以往以农业为核心的可持续发展政策在海洋领域的一种变体。在此，我们事前评估了提供渔业资本和农业资本的经济与环境影响，并考虑了是否实施禁止在近岸栖息地使用大型船只的渔业监管。我们综合运用发展经济学、自然资源经济学和海洋生态学的方法，利用一个独特的数据集和建模框架，来刻画家庭、商业部门、市场与当地鱼类种群之间的联系。我们表明，对当地海洋渔业或农业部门进行资本投资的政策，能够使目标家庭获得收入增长，但其连带效应会导致近岸鱼类捕捞量上升，因此难以实现农村沿海经济中的保护目标。然而，将农业刺激措施与加强执行现有渔业法规相结合，可能会带来双赢局面。尽管以海洋为基础的政策可能是实现联合国可持续发展目标中两项目标（减轻贫困和保护脆弱的海洋资源）的重要工具，但其成功绝非必然，并需要考虑农村经济中固有的陆地与海洋社会经济联系。

title: Market-driven bioeconomic general equilibrium impacts of tourism on resource-dependent local economies: A case from the western Philippines
Species protection in areas conserved through community-driven direct democracy as compared with a large private land trust in California
An integrated bioeconomic local economy-wide assessment of the environmental impacts of poverty programs
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Cash transfer programs assist hundreds of millions of poor individuals in developing countries. However, they create local demand shocks that can cause environmental damage. Degradation of the local environment has consequences for the well-being of local people, but these impacts have not been quantified. We model how cash transfers affect household incomes and market-driven natural resource use. We find that environmental degradation can reduce income benefits of these programs, particularly for individuals whose livelihoods depend directly on natural resources. Our results suggest that cash transfer programs need to be implemented in tandem with environmental policies to achieve welfare gains and mitigate environmental damages that in turn economically harm communities.
abstract_zh: 现金转移支付项目为发展中国家数亿贫困人口提供帮助。然而，这类项目会产生当地需求冲击，可能导致环境损害。当地环境的退化会对当地人民的福祉产生影响，但这些影响尚未得到量化。我们构建模型，考察现金转移支付如何影响家庭收入以及市场驱动的自然资源利用。我们发现，环境退化可能会减少这些项目的收入效益，对于那些生计直接依赖自然资源的人而言尤为如此。我们的结果表明，现金转移支付项目需要与环境政策配套实施，才能实现福利增进，并减轻那些最终会在经济上损害社区的环境损害。

Exploitation of a Mobile Resource with Costly Cooperation

title: Optimal Investment to Enable Evolutionary Rescue
Predicting the impact of future oil-spill closures on fishery-dependent communities - a spatially explicit approach
Recreational Leasing of Alaska Commercial Halibut Quota: The Early Years of the GAF Program in Alaska
Resilience of a commercial fishing fleet following emergency closures in the Gulf of Mexico
Building effective fishery ecosystem plans
abstract: U.S. fisheries management has made tremendous strides under the current management framework, which centers on single stocks rather than ecosystems. However, conventional management focuses on one fishing sector at a time, considers a narrow range of issues, and is separated into individual fishery management plans often leaving little opportunity to consider overarching management goals across fisheries. Ecosystem-based Fisheries Management (EBFM) provides mechanisms to address these but has not been widely adopted. Here, we review and analyze the development of Fisheries Ecosystem Plans (FEPs) as a means to implement EBFM. In doing so, we provide a blueprint for next-generation FEPS that have the potential to translate EBFM to action. We highlight FEPs as a structured planning process that uses adaptive management to operationalize EBFM. This “FEP Loop” process starts by identifying the key factors that shape a fishery system and considering them simultaneously, as a coherent whole. It then helps managers and stakeholders delineate their overarching goals for the system and refine them into specific, realistic projects. And it charts a course forward with a set of management actions that work in concert to achieve the highest-priority objectives. We conclude that EBFM is feasible today using existing science tools, policy instruments, and management structures. Not only that, nearly all of the steps in the proposed “FEP Loop” process are presently being carried out by U.S. fishery managers. The process of reviewing regional experiences in developing and applying the FEP loop will lead to adaptations and improvements of the process we propose.
abstract_zh: 在以单一种群而非生态系统为核心的现行管理框架下，美国渔业管理取得了巨大进展。然而，传统管理侧重于一次只关注一个捕捞部门，所考虑的议题范围狭窄，并且被划分为各自独立的渔业管理计划，这往往使跨渔业的总体管理目标难以得到统筹考虑。以生态系统为基础的渔业管理（EBFM）提供了解决这些问题的机制，但尚未得到广泛采用。本文回顾并分析了渔业生态系统计划（FEPs）的发展，将其作为实施EBFM的一种手段。通过这一分析，我们为下一代FEPs提供了蓝图，这些计划有潜力将EBFM转化为实际行动。我们强调，FEPs是一种结构化的规划过程，它利用适应性管理使EBFM具有可操作性。这一“FEP循环”过程首先识别塑造渔业系统的关键因素，并将其作为一个整体加以统筹考虑。随后，它帮助管理者和利益相关者明确系统的总体目标，并将这些目标细化为具体、切实可行的项目。最后，它为实现最优先目标制定一套协同发挥作用的管理行动路线。我们的结论是，利用现有的科学工具、政策工具和管理结构，EBFM在今天已经是可行的。不仅如此，提出的“FEP循环”过程中几乎所有步骤，目前都已由美国渔业管理者执行。回顾各地区在开发和应用FEP循环方面的经验，将促使我们对所提出的过程进行调整和改进。

title: Causal inference in coupled human and natural systems
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: Economic value of ecological information in ecosystem-based natural resource management depends on exploitation history
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Ecosystem approaches to natural resource management are seen as a way to provide better outcomes for ecosystems and for people, yet the nature and strength of interactions among ecosystem components is usually unknown. Here we characterize the economic benefits of ecological knowledge through a simple model of fisheries that target a predator (piscivore) and its prey. We solve for the management (harvest) trajectory that maximizes net present value (NPV) for different ecological interactions and initial conditions that represent different levels of exploitation history. Optimal management trajectories generally approached similar harvest levels, but the pathways toward those levels varied considerably by ecological scenario. Application of the wrong harvest trajectory, which would happen if one type of ecological interaction were assumed but in fact another were occurring, generally led to only modest reductions in NPV. However, the risks were not equal across fleets: risks of incurring large losses of NPV and missing management targets were much higher in the fishery targeting piscivores, especially when piscivores were heavily depleted. Our findings suggest that the ecosystem approach might provide the greatest benefits when used to identify system states where management performs poorly with imperfect knowledge of system linkages so that management strategies can be adopted to avoid those states.
abstract_zh: 以生态系统为基础的自然资源管理方法被视为一种能够为生态系统和人类带来更好结果的途径，然而生态系统各组成部分之间相互作用的性质和强度通常并不清楚。在此，我们通过一个针对捕食者（肉食性鱼类）及其猎物的简单渔业模型，刻画了生态知识的经济效益。我们针对不同的生态相互作用以及代表不同开发历史水平的初始条件，求解了使净现值（NPV）最大化的管理（捕捞）路径。最优管理路径通常会趋向相似的捕捞水平，但通往这些水平的路径因生态情景不同而差异显著。如果假设了某种生态相互作用，而实际上发生的却是另一种，则采用错误的捕捞路径，通常只会导致净现值的适度下降。然而，各渔业船队所面临的风险并不相等：在以肉食性鱼类为捕捞对象的渔业中，遭受大额净现值损失和错失管理目标的风险要高得多，尤其是在肉食性鱼类被大量耗竭时。我们的研究结果表明，当系统联系认知不完善时，生态系统方法可能在识别管理表现不佳的系统状态方面最具价值，从而可以采取管理策略来避免这些状态。

title: Evolution and future of the sustainable seafood market
Examination of the Peruvian Anchovy Individual Vessel Quota System
Identifying the Potential for Cross-Fishery Spillovers: A Network Analysis of Alaskan Permitting Patterns
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: Many fishers own a portfolio of permits across multiple fisheries, creating an opportunity for fishing effort to adjust across fisheries and enabling impacts from a policy change in one fishery to spill over into other fisheries. In regions with a large and diverse number of permits and fisheries, joint-permitting can result in a complex system, making it difficult to understand the potential for cross-fishery substitution. In this study, we construct a network representation of permit ownership to characterize interconnectedness among Alaska commercial fisheries due to cross-fishery permitting. The Alaska fisheries network is highly connected, suggesting that most fisheries are vulnerable to cross-fishery spillovers from network shocks, such as changes to policies or fish stocks. We find that fisheries with similar geographic proximity are more likely to be a part of a highly connected cluster of susceptible fisheries. We use a case study to show that preexisting network statistics can be useful for identifying the potential scope of policy-induced spillovers. Our results demonstrate that network analysis can improve our understanding of the potential for policy-induced cross-fishery spillovers.
abstract_zh: 许多渔民持有跨多个渔业的捕捞许可证组合，这使得捕捞努力量能够在不同渔业之间调整，也使得某一渔业的政策变化可能溢出到其他渔业。在许可证和渔业数量庞大且多样的地区，联合许可可能形成复杂的系统，使得理解跨渔业替代的潜力变得困难。在本研究中，我们构建了许可证持有的网络表示，以刻画阿拉斯加商业渔业之间因跨渔业许可而形成的相互联系。阿拉斯加渔业网络的连接度很高，这表明大多数渔业容易受到网络冲击（如政策或鱼类种群变化）所引发的跨渔业溢出效应的影响。我们发现，地理位置相近的渔业更有可能属于一个高度关联且易受影响的渔业集群。我们通过一个案例研究表明，既有的网络统计量有助于识别政策引发溢出效应的潜在范围。我们的结果表明，网络分析能够增进我们对政策引发的跨渔业溢出可能性的理解。

title: Slow treatment promotes control of harmful species by multiple agents
Vessel monitoring systems (VMS) reveal an increase in fishing efficiency following regulatory changes in a demersal longline fishery
Avoiding a crisis of motivation for ocean management under global environmental change
abstract: Climate change and ocean acidification are altering marine ecosystems and, from a human perspective, creating both winners and losers. Human responses to these changes are complex, but may result in reduced government investments in regulation, resource management, monitoring and enforcement. Moreover, a lack of peoples’ experience of climate change may drive some towards attributing the symptoms of climate change to more familiar causes such as management failure. Taken together, we anticipate that management could become weaker and less effective as climate change continues. Using diverse case studies, including the decline of coral reefs, coastal defences from flooding, shifting fish stocks and the emergence of new shipping opportunities in the Arctic, we argue that human interests are better served by increased investments in resource management. But greater government investment in management does not simply mean more of “business‐as‐usual.” Management needs to become more flexible, better at anticipating and responding to surprise, and able to facilitate change where it is desirable. A range of technological, economic, communication and governance solutions exists to help transform management. While not all have been tested, judicious application of the most appropriate solutions should help humanity adapt to novel circumstances and seek opportunity where possible.
abstract_zh: 气候变化和海洋酸化正在改变海洋生态系统，从人类视角看，它们既创造了赢家，也造成了输家。人类对这些变化的应对是复杂的，但可能导致政府在监管、资源管理、监测和执法方面的投入减少。此外，人们缺乏对气候变化的直接体验，可能导致一些人将气候变化的表现归因于更为熟悉的原因，例如管理失败。综合来看，我们预计，随着气候变化持续推进，管理可能会变得更加薄弱，效力也会下降。通过珊瑚礁衰退、洪水的海岸防护、鱼类种群迁移以及北极新航运机会的出现等多样化案例，我们认为，增加对资源管理的投入更能服务于人类利益。但政府加大管理投入并不仅仅意味着“照常营业”。管理需要变得更加灵活，更善于预见和应对意外情况，并能够促成人们所期望的变化。目前已存在一系列技术、经济、传播和治理方面的解决方案，有助于推动管理转型。尽管并非所有方案都经过了检验，但对最合适的解决方案进行审慎应用，应有助于人类适应新的环境，并在可能的情况下把握机遇。

title: Implications of Policy Adjustment Costs for Fisheries Management
abstract: Optimal policy recommendations from natural resource management models can involve fast‐changing management interventions. Actual policies often change more gradually, potentially reflecting costs associated with policy adjustment. We examine how including policy adjustment costs changes policy recommendations in models of fishery management. Specifically, we examine cases where policy adjustment costs increase at an increasing rate with the rate of change of fishing effort levels. We examine how accounting for these costs changes optimal management strategies in static and time‐varying environments. Increasing policy adjustment costs results in optimal approach paths to stationary optimal solutions that are more gradual but that rely on oscillatory convergence. In time‐varying environments, including policy adjustment costs smoothes optimal management recommendations, resulting in decreased variation in effort levels on the stationary part of the optimal solution, but increased variation in optimal stock sizes. We conclude that accounting for policy adjustment costs in this way leads to management recommendations that in some ways would be simpler for managers to implement (more gradual approach paths), but in other ways more challenging (oscillatory convergence) and that can affect where environmental variability is expressed in model predictions (stock sizes versus effort levels) while not suppressing this variability altogether.
abstract_zh: 自然资源管理模型给出的最优政策建议，有时会涉及快速变化的管理干预。而现实中的政策往往调整得更为渐进，这可能反映了政策调整所伴随的成本。我们考察了在渔业管理模型中纳入政策调整成本，会如何改变政策建议。具体而言，我们考察了这样一种情形：政策调整成本随着捕捞努力量水平变化速率的提高而以递增速率上升。我们研究了在静态和时变环境中，考虑这些成本会如何改变最优管理策略。政策调整成本的增加，会使通往稳态最优解的最优路径更为渐进，但这些路径依赖于振荡收敛。在时变环境中，纳入政策调整成本会使最优管理建议趋于平滑，导致最优解稳态部分的捕捞努力量水平变异减少，但最优鱼类种群规模的变异增加。我们的结论是，以这种方式考虑政策调整成本，会产生一些对管理者而言在某些方面更易于执行的管理建议（路径更为渐进），但在另一些方面则更具挑战性（振荡收敛）；并且它会影响环境变异在模型预测中的体现位置（是体现在鱼类种群规模上，还是体现在捕捞努力量水平上），但并不会完全抹去这种变异。

title: The Effectiveness, Costs and Coastal Protection Benefits of Natural and Nature-Based Defences
A novel model of predator prey interactions reveals the sensitivity of forage fish-piscivore fishery trade-offs to ecological conditions
abstract: Ecosystem-based fisheries management seeks to consider trade-offs among management objectives for interacting species, such as those that arise through predator–prey linkages. In particular, fisheries-targeting forage fish (small and abundant pelagic fish) might have a detrimental effect on fisheries-targeting predators that consume them. However, complexities in ecological interactions might dampen, negate, or even reverse this trade-off, because small pelagic fish can be important predators on egg stages of piscivorous fish. Further, the strength of this trade-off might depend on the extent to which piscivorous fish targeted by fisheries regulate forage species productivity. Here, we developed a novel delay-differential bioeconomic model of predator–prey and fishing dynamics to quantify how much egg predation or weak top-town control affects the strength of trade-off between forage and piscivore fisheries, and to measure how ecological interactions dictate policies that maximize steady-state profits. We parameterized the model based on ecological and economic data from the North Sea Atlantic cod (Gadus morhua) and Atlantic herring (Clupea harengus). The optimal policy was very sensitive to the ecological interactions (either egg predation or weak top-down control of forage by predators) at relatively low forage prices but was less sensitive at high forage fish prices. However, the optimal equilibrium harvest rates on forage and piscivores were not substantially different from what might be derived through analyses that did not consider species interactions. Applying the optimal multispecies policy would produce substantial losses (>25%) in profits in the piscivore fishery, and the extent of loss was sensitive to ecological scenarios. While our equilibrium analysis is informative, a dynamic analysis under similar ecological scenarios is necessary to reveal the full economic and ecological benefits of applying ecosystem-based fishery management policies to predator–prey fishery systems.
abstract_zh: 以生态系统为基础的渔业管理旨在兼顾相互作用物种（例如通过捕食者与猎物之间的联系而产生的相互作用物种）之间的管理目标权衡。特别是，以饵料鱼（小型且数量丰富的中上层鱼类）为捕捞对象的渔业，可能会对以捕食饵料鱼为生的肉食性鱼类渔业产生不利影响。然而，生态相互作用的复杂性可能会减弱、抵消甚至逆转这种权衡，因为小型中上层鱼类本身可能是肉食性鱼类卵的重要捕食者。此外，这种权衡的强度可能取决于作为捕捞对象的肉食性鱼类在多大程度上调控饵料物种的生产力。在此，我们构建了一个新颖的时滞生物经济模型，用以刻画捕食者—猎物关系和捕捞动态，从而量化卵捕食或弱自上而下控制如何影响饵料鱼与肉食性鱼类渔业之间权衡的强度，并衡量生态相互作用如何决定使稳态利润最大化的政策。我们基于北海大西洋鳕鱼（Gadus morhua）和大西洋鲱鱼（Clupea harengus）的生态与经济数据对模型进行了参数化。在相对较低的饵料鱼价格下，最优政策对生态相互作用（卵捕食或捕食者对饵料鱼的弱自上而下控制）非常敏感，但在饵料鱼价格较高时则不那么敏感。然而，饵料鱼和肉食性鱼类的最优均衡捕捞率，与未考虑物种相互作用的分析所得结果并无显著差异。在肉食性鱼类渔业中，实施这一最优多物种政策将导致利润大幅损失（超过25%），且损失程度对生态情景十分敏感。尽管我们的均衡分析具有一定参考价值，但仍需在类似的生态情景下进行动态分析，以揭示将以生态系统为基础的渔业管理政策应用于捕食者—猎物渔业系统所带来的全部经济与生态效益。

title: Optimal management of a stochastically varying population when policy adjustment is costly
Secure Sustainable Seafood from Developing Countries
The Bioeconomics of Spatial-Dynamical Systems in Natural Resource Management
Benefits of the Ballot Box for Species Conservation
abstract: Recent estimates reaffirm that conservation funds are insufficient to meet biodiversity conservation goals. Organisations focused on biodiversity conservation therefore need to capitalise on investments that societies make in environmental protection that provide ancillary benefits to biodiversity. Here, we undertake the first assessment of the potential ancillary benefits from the ballot box in the United States, where citizens vote on referenda to conserve lands for reasons that may not include biodiversity directly but that indirectly might enhance biodiversity conservation. Our results suggest that referenda occur in counties with significantly greater biodiversity than counties chosen at random. We also demonstrate that large potential gains for conservation are possible if the past and likely future outcomes of these ballot box measures are directly incorporated into national‐scale conservation planning efforts. The possible synergies between ballot box measures and other biodiversity conservation efforts offer an under‐utilised resource for supporting conservation.
abstract_zh: 近期的估计再次证实，保护资金不足以实现生物多样性保护目标。因此，致力于生物多样性保护的组织需要充分利用社会在环境保护方面的投入，因为这些投入会为生物多样性带来附带效益。在此，我们首次评估了美国选票箱所带来的潜在附带效益。在美国，公民会就保护土地的公投进行表决。这些公投的理由可能并不直接包含生物多样性，但可能间接促进生物多样性保护。我们的结果表明，进行此类公投的县，其生物多样性显著高于随机抽取的县。我们还证明，如果将这些选票箱措施过去和未来可能的结果直接纳入全国尺度的保护规划工作，则可能带来巨大的保护收益。选票箱措施与其他生物多样性保护努力之间可能存在的协同效应，为支持保护工作提供了一种尚未充分利用的资源。

title: High vulnerability of ecosystem function and services to diversity loss in Caribbean coral reefs
Investment and the Policy Process in Conservation Monitoring
abstract:
Despite decades of discussion and implementation, conservation monitoring remains a challenge. Many current solutions in the literature focus on improving the science or making more structured decisions. These insights are important but incomplete in accounting for the politics and economics of the conservation decisions informed by monitoring. Our novel depiction of the monitoring enterprise unifies insights from multiple disciplines (conservation, operations research, economics, and policy) and highlights many underappreciated factors that affect the expected benefits of monitoring. For example, there must be a strong link between the specific needs of decision makers and information gathering. Furthermore, the involvement of stakeholders other than scientists and research managers means that new information may not be interpreted and acted upon as expected. While answering calls for sharply delineated objectives will clearly add focus to monitoring efforts, for practical reasons, high‐level goals may purposefully be left vague, to facilitate other necessary steps in the policy process. We use the expanded depiction of the monitoring process to highlight problems of cooperation and conflict. We critique calls to invest in monitoring for the greater good by arguing that incentives are typically lacking. Although the benefits of learning accrued within a project (e.g., improving management) provide incentives for investing in some monitoring, it is unrealistic, in general, to expect managers to add potentially costly measures to generate shared benefits. In the traditional linear model of the role of science in policy decisions, monitoring reduces uncertainty and decision makers are rational, unbiased consumers of the science. However, conservation actions increasingly involve social conflict. Drawing insights from political science, we argue that in high‐conflict situations, it is necessary to address the conflict prior to monitoring.
Las Inversiones y el Proceso de Políticas en el Monitoreo de la Conservación Sanchirico et al.
abstract_zh:
尽管经过数十年的讨论和实践，保护监测仍然是一项挑战。文献中的许多现有解决方案侧重于改进科学研究或使决策更加结构化。这些见解固然重要，但在解释保护决策背后的政治与经济因素方面仍不完整，而这些决策正是由监测信息支撑的。我们对监测过程的新描绘，整合了多个学科（保护生物学、运筹学、经济学和政策学）的见解，并突出了许多未被充分重视、却会影响监测预期收益的因素。例如，决策者的具体需求与信息收集之间必须存在紧密联系。此外，科学家和研究管理者之外的利益相关者的参与意味着，新信息未必会按预期被解读和采取行动。虽然明确的目标陈述无疑会使监测工作更加聚焦，但出于现实原因，高层次的目标有时会被刻意保持模糊，以便为政策过程中其他必要步骤留出空间。我们利用扩展后的监测过程描绘来揭示合作与冲突的问题。我们对基于为了更大利益而投资监测的呼吁提出了批评，认为激励机制通常是缺失的。尽管项目内部的学习收益（例如改善管理）为某些监测投资提供了激励，但通常而言，指望管理者承担可能代价高昂的措施以产生共享收益，是不现实的。在科学服务于政策决策的传统线性模型中，监测会降低不确定性，而决策者是理性且无偏的科学消费者。然而，保护行动日益涉及社会冲突。借鉴政治学的见解，我们认为，在高度冲突的情境下，有必要先解决冲突，再开展监测。
《保护监测中的投资与政策过程》（西班牙语版标题） Sanchirico et al.

title: Measuring benefits from a marketing cooperative in the Copper River fishery
abstract: The degradation of product quality is one form of rent dissipation resulting from incomplete property rights in fisheries. Industry structure and information asymmetries can also lead to underinvestment in product quality, even when property rights are well defined. In this article we empirically examine whether the voluntary formation of a marketing cooperative was able to mitigate market failures that led to the production of inferior‐quality fish. Specifically, we use a difference‐in‐differences estimation strategy to measure the impact that the Copper River Fishermen's Cooperative, an Alaskan salmon marketing cooperative, had on ex‐vessel salmon prices and salmon quality measures. We find that the cooperative was able to improve product quality, as well as attract and sustain a higher price for its salmon. Our findings provide empirical support for many of the key tenets of cooperative theory. Specifically, we find evidence that marketing cooperatives can address existing market failures, that marketing cooperatives can have advantages in high‐quality product markets, and that over time, as a result of their success, marketing cooperatives may lead to lasting producer benefits even though they become obsolete due to nonmember free‐riding.
abstract_zh: 产品质量下降是渔业产权不完整所导致的一种租金耗散形式。即使产权界定清晰，行业结构和信息不对称也可能导致对产品质量的投资不足。在本文中，我们实证检验了自愿组建的营销合作社能否缓解导致劣质鱼产品生产的市场失灵。具体而言，我们采用双重差分估计策略，衡量阿拉斯加鲑鱼营销合作社——铜河渔民合作社（Copper River Fishermen's Cooperative）——对船边鲑鱼价格和鲑鱼质量指标的影响。我们发现，该合作社能够提升产品质量，并为其鲑鱼吸引和维持更高的价格。我们的研究结果为合作社理论的许多核心观点提供了实证支持。具体而言，我们发现有证据表明，营销合作社能够解决现存的市场失灵，在高质量产品市场中具有优势，并且随着其取得成功，营销合作社即使因非成员搭便车而变得过时，仍可能带来持久的生产者收益。

title: Reexamining the science of marine protected areas: linking knowledge to action
Trends, current understanding, and future research priorities for artisanal coral reef fisheries research
abstract: Artisanal coral reef fisheries provide food and employment to hundreds of millions of people in developing countries, making their sustainability a high priority. However, many of these fisheries are degraded and not yielding their maximum socioeconomic returns. We present a literature review that evaluates foci and trends in research effort on coral reef fisheries. We describe the types of data and categories of management recommendations presented in the 464 peer‐reviewed articles returned. Identified trends include a decline in articles reporting time‐series data, fish catch biomass and catch‐per‐unit effort, and an increase in articles containing bycatch and stakeholder interview data. Management implications were discussed in 80% of articles, with increasing frequency over time, but only 22% of articles made management recommendations based on the research presented in the article, as opposed to more general recommendations. Key future research priorities, which we deem underrepresented in the literature at present, are: (i) effectiveness of management approaches, (ii) ecological thresholds, trade‐offs and sustainable levels of extraction, (iii) effects of climate change, (iv) food security, (v) the role of aquaculture, (vi) access to and control of fishery resources, (vii) relationships between economic development and fishery exploitation, (viii) alternative livelihoods and (ix) integration of ecological and socioeconomic research.
abstract_zh: 手工珊瑚礁渔业为发展中国家数以亿计的人口提供食物和就业，因此其可持续性是高度优先的议题。然而，其中许多渔业已经退化，未能获得其最大的社会经济回报。我们开展了一项文献综述，评估珊瑚礁渔业研究的重点和趋势。我们描述了所检索到的464篇同行评审论文中所呈现的数据类型和管理建议类别。所识别的趋势包括：报告时间序列数据、鱼类捕获生物量以及单位捕捞努力量渔获量（CPUE）的文章减少，而包含兼捕和利益相关者访谈数据的文章增加。80%的文章讨论了管理启示，且这一比例随时间推移而增加，但只有22%的文章基于本文所呈现的研究提出了管理建议，其余多为较为一般性的建议。我们认为，目前文献中代表性不足的关键未来研究重点包括：（i）管理方法的有效性，（ii）生态阈值、权衡与可持续开采水平，（iii）气候变化的影响，（iv）粮食安全，（v）水产养殖的作用，（vi）渔业资源的获取与控制，（vii）经济发展与渔业开发之间的关系，（viii）替代生计，以及（ix）生态研究与社会经济研究的整合。

title: How to get there from here: Ecological and economic dynamics of ecosystem service provision
abstract: Using a bioeconomic model of a coral reef-mangrove-seagrass system, we analyze the dynamic path of incentives to achieve an efficient transition to the steady state levels of fish biomass and mangrove habitat conservation. Our model nests different types of species habitat dependency and allows for changes in the extent of habitat to affect the growth rate and the long-run fish level. We solve the two-control, two-state non-linear optimal control problem numerically and compute the input efficiency frontier characterizing the tradeoff between mangrove habitat and fish population. After identifying the optimal locus on the frontier, we determine the optimal transition path to the frontier from a set of initial conditions to illustrate the necessary investments. Finally, we demonstrate how dynamic conservation incentives (payments for ecosystem services) for a particular habitat with multiple services are interdependent, change over time, and can be greater than contemporaneous fishing profits when the ecosystem is degraded.
abstract_zh: 利用珊瑚礁—红树林—海草系统的生物经济模型，我们分析了实现鱼类生物量和红树林生境保护稳态水平高效转型的激励动态路径。我们的模型涵盖了不同类型的物种生境依赖关系，并允许生境范围的变化影响增长率和长期鱼类水平。我们以数值方法求解了双控制变量、双状态变量的非线性最优控制问题，并计算出刻画红树林生境与鱼类种群之间权衡的投入效率前沿。在确定前沿上的最优位置之后，我们从一组初始条件出发，确定通往前沿的最优转型路径，以说明所需的投资。最后，我们展示了对于具有多种服务功能的特定生境，动态保护激励（生态系统服务付费）如何相互依存、随时间变化，并且当生态系统退化时，其数值可能超过同期的捕捞利润。

title: Optimizing for multiple species and multiple values: Tradeoffs inherent in ecosystem-based fisheries management
Comprehensive planning, dominant-use zones, and user rights: a new era in ocean governance
Economic Analysis for Ecosystem Based Management: Applications to Marine and Coastal Environments
abstract: Ocean and coastal management regimes are increasingly subject to competing demands from stakeholders. Regulations must not only address fishing, recreation, and shipping, but also sand and gravel mining, gas pipelines, harbor/port development, offshore wind and tidal energy facilities, liquefied natural gas terminals, offshore aquaculture, and desalinization plants. The growing variety and intensity of ocean and coastal uses increases the call for a more holistic, comprehensive, and coordinated management approach that recognizes the often complex relationships between natural and human systems. For both economist and non-economist audiences, this book describes ways in which economic analysis can be an important tool to inform and improve ecosystem-based management (EBM). Topics include modeling economic impacts, benefit-cost analysis, spatial considerations in EBM, incentives and human behaviors, and accounting for uncertainty in policy analysis. Throughout the book the authors elucidate the different kinds of insights which can be gained from the use of different economic tools. In this rigorous and accessible work, the authors defy the conventional stereotype that economic perspectives necessarily favor the greatest commercial development. Instead, they demonstrate how comprehensive economic analyses consider the full range of potential services offered by marine and coastal ecosystems, including the conservation of biodiversity and creation of recreational opportunities.
abstract_zh: 海洋和沿海的管理体制面临着来自利益相关者日益激烈的竞争性需求。监管不仅必须处理捕捞、休闲和航运，还必须涉及采砂采石、天然气管道、港口开发、海上风电和潮汐能设施、液化天然气接收站、海上水产养殖以及海水淡化厂等问题。海洋和沿海利用的种类与强度日益增加，这推动人们采取更加整体、全面和协调的管理方法，以认识自然系统与人类系统之间往往复杂的关系。本书面向经济学和非经济学读者，描述了经济分析如何成为改进以生态系统为基础的管理（EBM）的重要工具。主题包括经济影响建模、成本效益分析、EBM中的空间考量、激励机制与人类行为，以及政策分析中的不确定性处理。全书中，作者阐明了运用不同经济工具所能获得的不同类型的洞见。在这部严谨而通俗易懂的著作中，作者打破了经济视角必然偏向最大商业开发的传统刻板印象。相反，他们展示了全面的经济分析如何考虑海洋和沿海生态系统所提供的全部潜在服务，包括生物多样性保护和休闲机会的创造。

title: Economically optimal management of a metapopulation
Invasive Species Management in a Spatially Heterogeneous World: Spatial vs. Uniform Policies
Optimal rebuilding of a metapopulation
Regional patterns of U.S. household carbon emissions
abstract: Market-based policies to address fossil fuel-related externalities including climate change typically operate by raising the price of those fuels. Increases in energy prices have important consequences for a typical U.S. household that spent almost $4,000 per year on electricity, fuel oil, natural gas, and gasoline in 2005. A key question for policymakers is how these consequences vary over different regions and subpopulations across the country—especially as adjustment and compensation programs are designed to protect more vulnerable regions. To answer this question, we use non-publicly available data from the U.S. Consumer Expenditure Survey over the period 1984–2000 to estimate long-run geographic variation in household use of electricity, fuel oil, natural gas, and gasoline, as well as the associated incidence of a $10 per ton tax on carbon dioxide (ignoring behavioral response). We find substantial variation: incidence from the tax range from $97 dollars per year per household in New York County, New York to $235 per year per household in Tensas Parish, Louisiana. This variation can be explained by differences in energy use, carbon intensity of electricity generation, and electricity regulation.
abstract_zh: 旨在应对化石燃料相关外部性（包括气候变化）的市场化政策，通常通过提高这些燃料的价格来发挥作用。能源价格的上涨对典型美国家庭产生重要影响，该家庭在2005年每年在电力、燃料油、天然气和汽油上的支出已接近4000美元。政策制定者面临的一个关键问题是，这些影响在全国不同地区和不同人群之间如何变化，特别是在为保护较脆弱地区而设计的调整和补偿项目中。为回答这一问题，我们利用美国消费者支出调查1984至2000年间的非公开数据，估计了家庭在电力、燃料油、天然气和汽油使用方面的长期地理差异，以及每吨二氧化碳征收10美元碳税所对应的负担分布（不考虑行为反应）。我们发现存在显著差异：碳税的负担从纽约州纽约县的每户每年97美元，到路易斯安那州坦萨斯教区的每户每年235美元不等。这种差异可以由能源使用差异、发电的碳强度以及电力监管的不同来解释。

title: An approach to ecosystem-based fishery management
Coral reef habitats as surrogates of species, ecological functions and ecosystem services
abstract:
Habitat maps are often the core spatially consistent data set on which marine reserve networks are designed, but their efficacy as surrogates for species richness and applicability to other conservation measures is poorly understood. Combining an analysis of field survey data, literature review, and expert assessment by a multidisciplinary working group, we examined the degree to which Caribbean coastal habitats provide useful planning information on 4 conservation measures: species richness, the ecological functions of fish species, ecosystem processes, and ecosystem services. Approximately one‐quarter to one‐third of benthic invertebrate species and fish species (disaggregated by life phase; hereafter fish species) occurred in a single habitat, and
Montastraea
‐dominated forereefs consistently had the highest richness of all species, processes, and services. All 11 habitats were needed to represent all 277 fish species in the seascape, although reducing the conservation target to 95% of species approximately halved the number of habitats required to ensure representation. Species accumulation indices (SAIs) were used to compare the efficacy of surrogates and revealed that fish species were a more appropriate surrogate of benthic species (SAI = 71%) than benthic species were for fishes (SAI = 42%). Species of reef fishes were also distributed more widely across the seascape than invertebrates and therefore their use as a surrogate simultaneously included mangroves, sea grass, and coral reef habitats. Functional classes of fishes served as effective surrogates of fish and benthic species which, given their ease to survey, makes them a particularly useful measure for conservation planning. Ecosystem processes and services exhibited great redundancy among habitats and were ineffective as surrogates of species. Therefore, processes and services in this case were generally unsuitable for a complementarity‐based approach to reserve design. In contrast, the representation of species or functional classes ensured inclusion of all processes and services in the reserve network.
abstract_zh: 生境图通常是设计海洋保护区网络所依据的核心空间一致性数据集，但它们作为物种丰富度替代指标以及适用于其他保护措施的效力，目前理解得并不充分。我们结合野外调查数据分析、文献综述以及由多学科工作组进行的专家评估，考察了加勒比海沿岸生境在四类保护目标上提供有用规划信息的程度：物种丰富度、鱼类物种的生态功能、生态过程以及生态系统服务。大约四分之一至三分之一的底栖无脊椎动物物种和鱼类物种（按生活史阶段区分，以下简称鱼类物种）仅出现在单一生境中；以Montastraea为主的前礁，在所有物种、过程和服务方面的丰富度始终最高。在所研究的海景中，需要全部11种生境才能代表全部277种鱼类物种，但若将保护目标降至95%的物种，所需生境数量大约减半即可确保代表性。我们使用物种积累指数（SAI）比较替代指标的效力，结果显示，鱼类物种作为底栖物种的替代指标（SAI = 71%）比底栖物种作为鱼类的替代指标（SAI = 42%）更为恰当。礁鱼的分布也比无脊椎动物更为广泛，因此，将其作为替代指标时能够同时涵盖红树林、海草和珊瑚礁生境。鱼类的功能类群可以有效地替代鱼类和底栖物种，鉴于其易于调查，这使其成为保护规划中特别实用的指标。在生态过程和生态系统服务方面，各生境之间存在大量冗余，它们作为物种的替代指标效果不佳。因此，在这一案例中，这些过程和服务总体上并不适合基于互补性的保护区设计方法。相反，物种或功能类群的代表性，能够确保保护区网络涵盖所有的过程和服务。

abstract: In this review we discuss the economic implications of spatial-dynamic processes operating at various scales in coupled human and natural systems where the coupling is through the harvest of a renewable resource. Before introducing the spatial aspects, we first summarize in Section 2 the economic conclusions of the seminal non-spatial bioeconomic research. In Section 3, we elaborate on some of the new findings about spatial patterns and processes in marine ecosystems with metapopulation models. These generalizations of the basic lumped parameter models include both larval and adult dispersal processes, and offer a parsimonious modeling approach for depicting spatially linked resources. Section 4 explores the bioeconomic implications of this new metapopulation paradigm under polar extreme institutional assumptions of open access and sole owner optimal use. We discuss in Section 5 the special issue of marine nature reserves or no-take zones. Section 6 discusses the institutional implications of the new spatial paradigm and the connections with similar investigations in other policy arenas.
abstract_zh: 在本综述中，我们讨论了在人类与自然耦合系统中，各种尺度上的空间动态过程所带来的经济含义，其中耦合通过对可再生资源的开采而实现。在引入空间维度之前，我们首先在第2节中总结了开创性非空间生物经济学研究的经济结论。在第3节中，我们借助集合种群模型，阐述了海洋生态系统中空间格局与过程的一些新发现。这些对基本集总参数模型的推广，既包括幼体扩散，也包括成体扩散过程，并为刻画空间关联资源提供了一种简约的建模方法。第4节在开放获取和唯一所有者最优利用这两种极端的制度假设下，探讨了这一新的集合种群范式的生物经济含义。第5节讨论了海洋自然保护区或禁渔区的特殊问题。第6节讨论了这一新空间范式的制度含义，以及它与其他政策领域类似研究之间的联系。

title: The Effectiveness of Buying Easements as a Conservation Strategy
abstract: Easements offer an increasingly popular approach to habitat conservation. We use first principle economic models to examine the effectiveness of easements for protecting biodiversity from development. We compare buying reserves, buying easements, and a preacquisition strategy, in which properties are purchased outright before being sold on with an easement attached. The effectiveness of easements depends on the value of open land for biodiversity and the information available regarding landowners' valuations of low impact land uses. Easements are particularly effective where there are alternative land parcels available to developers and when landowners' values for continuing with biodiversity friendly production methods are relatively uniform. Buying reserves outright is the best approach when land supply is exhausted and developers have little option but to rely on land of conservation concern. Preacquisition can broaden the set of ecological and economic conditions for which an easement‐based approach is advantageous when faced with high initial uncertainty about private land values.
abstract_zh: 地役权（easement）是一种日益流行的栖息地保护方式。我们运用第一性原理的经济模型，考察了地役权在保护生物多样性免受开发影响方面的有效性。我们比较了三种策略：购买保护区、购买地役权，以及预先收购策略，即先整体购买地产，再附加地役权后转售。地役权的有效性取决于开阔土地对生物多样性的价值，以及关于土地所有者对低影响土地利用方式估值的可得信息。当开发商可以选择其他地块，并且土地所有者对继续采用生物友好型生产方式的价值较为一致时，地役权尤为有效。当土地供给耗尽，开发商别无选择而只能依赖具有保护价值的土地时，直接整体购买保护区是最佳方案。当面对私人土地价值的高度初始不确定性时，预先收购策略能够拓宽基于地役权方法具有优势的生态和经济条件范围。

title: Modeling Costs of Economy-wide versus Sectoral Climate Policies using Combined Aggregate-Sectoral Models
When are no-take zones an economically optimal fishery management strategy?
abstract: Discussions on the use of marine reserves (no-take zones) and, more generally, spatial management of fisheries are, for the most part, devoid of analyses that consider the ecological and economic effects simultaneously. To fill this gap, we develop a two-patch ecological-economic model to investigate the effects of spatial management on fishery profits. Because the fishery effects of spatial management depend critically on the nature of the ecological connectivity, our model includes both juvenile and adult movement, with density dependence in settlement differentiating the two types of dispersal. Rather than imposing a reserve on our system and measuring its effect on profits, we ask: "When does setting catch levels to maximize system-wide profits imply that a reserve should be created?" Closing areas to fishing is an economically optimal solution when the value derived from spillover from the reserve outweighs the value of fishing in the patch. The condition, while simple to state in summary form, is complex to interpret because it depends on the settlement success of the dispersing organisms, the nature of the costs of the fishing, the economic and ecological heterogeneity of the system, the discount rate, and growth characteristics of the fish population. The condition is more likely to be satisfied when the closed area is a net exporter of biomass and has higher costs of fishing, and for fish populations with density-independent settlement ("adult movement") than with density-dependent settlement ("larval dispersal"). Rather surprisingly, there are circumstances whereby closing low biological productivity areas, and even sometimes low cost areas to fish, can result in greater fishing profits than when both areas are open to fishing.
abstract_zh: 关于禁渔区（禁捕区）的使用，以及更广泛意义上的渔业空间管理的讨论，大多缺乏同时考虑生态和经济效应的分析。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个双斑块生态经济模型，以考察空间管理对渔业利润的影响。由于渔业的空间管理效果在很大程度上取决于生态连通性的性质，我们的模型同时纳入了幼体和成体的移动，并以定居过程中的密度依赖性来区分这两种扩散方式。我们并不是在系统中强加一个保护区再衡量其对利润的影响，而是提出问题：“当设定捕捞量以使整个系统利润最大化时，何时意味着应当设立保护区？”当来自保护区的外溢价值超过在该斑块中捕捞的价值时，关闭某些区域禁止捕捞就是经济上的最优解。该条件虽然在概要形式上表述简单，但解释起来十分复杂，因为它取决于扩散生物的定居成功率、捕捞成本的性质、系统的经济与生态异质性、贴现率以及鱼类种群的生长特征。当封闭区域是生物量的净输出者且捕捞成本较高时，以及对于定居与密度无关（“成体移动”）的鱼类种群而言，该条件更有可能得到满足，而非定居与密度相关（“幼体扩散”）的情形。相当出人意料的是，在某些情况下，关闭低生物生产力区域，甚至有时关闭低成本区域的捕捞，可能比两个区域都开放捕捞时获得更高的渔业利润。

venue: Tradeable Permits: Policy Evaluation, Design and Reform
abstract: The New Zealand ITQ system is a dynamic institution that has had many refinements since its inception more than 15 years ago. Nonetheless, the basic tenets of the system - setting a total allowable catch and leaving the market to determine the most profitable allocation of fishing effort - have remained intact. This paper assesses the New Zealand system to identify areas of success and/or possible improvement or expansion within it. The reasons for doing so are to highlight beneficial features and to identify features of the New Zealand ITQ system that are relevant to other potential tradable permit markets. Beneficial features include simple standardized rules for quota definition and trading across species and areas; very few restrictions on quota trading and holding; relative stability in the rules over time; and low levels of government involvement in the trading process. We find evidence that supports the assertion that fishers behave in a reasonably rational fashion and that the markets are relatively efficient. We do not find major changes in participation in these fisheries as a result of the system. We find evidence that suggests that the ITQ system is improving the profitability of fisheries in New Zealand. In general the evidence thus far suggests that the market is operating in a reasonably efficient manner and is providing significant economic gains. These factors suggest that New Zealand would want to have non-economic justifications for any significant changes to the system.
abstract_zh: 新西兰的个体可转让配额（ITQ）制度是一个动态的制度，自其15年多前实施以来经历了诸多改进。尽管如此，其基本原则——设定总可捕量（TAC），并让市场决定最有利可图的捕捞努力量分配——仍然保持不变。本文对新西兰制度进行了评估，以找出其成功之处和/或可改进或扩展之处。开展此项评估的目的，是突出其有益特征，并找出新西兰ITQ制度中与其他潜在可交易许可市场相关的特征。有益特征包括：跨物种和跨区域的配额界定与交易采用简单统一的规则；对配额交易和持有的限制非常少；规则随时间相对稳定；以及政府在交易过程中的参与程度较低。我们发现有证据支持以下论断：渔民的行为较为理性，市场也相对有效。我们没有发现该制度导致这些渔业的参与者发生重大变化。我们发现有证据表明，ITQ制度提高了新西兰渔业的盈利能力。总体而言，迄今为止的证据表明，市场运行相当有效，并带来了显著的经济收益。这些因素表明，若要对该制度进行任何重大改变，新西兰可能需要有非经济层面的理由。

title: Navigating U.S. Fishery Policy Into the 21st Century
Managing Marine Capture Fisheries with Incentive Based Price Instruments
abstract: Marine capture fisheries provide important, high-quality sources of protein, income and trade throughout the world. The future availability of these resources, however, is not assured, as economic and biological overfishing plagues many of the world's fisheries. In this paper, we review the use of incentive-based price instruments, such as landings and vessel taxes, to address the current crisis. We also investigate the use of price instruments as indirect means to ensure sustainability of marine mammal populations, and to optimally manage spatially distinct but connected populations.
abstract_zh: 海洋捕捞渔业为全世界提供了重要且优质的蛋白质来源，同时也是收入和贸易的重要来源。然而，这些资源的未来供给并无保障，因为经济和生物过度捕捞困扰着世界上许多渔业。在本文中，我们回顾了以激励为基础的价格工具（如卸鱼量税和船舶税）在应对当前危机中的应用。我们还考察了利用价格工具间接确保海洋哺乳动物种群可持续性的做法，以及用于最优管理空间上相互分隔但彼此相连种群的方法。
